simple.summary: תּוֹלָד (Tôwlâd) means Tolad , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: 1Chr 4 29.

definitions.full: H8434. Tolad תּוֺלָ֑ד proper name, of a location in Simeon 1Chr 4:29 , ᵐ5 Θουλαεμ , A Θωλαδ , ᵐ5 L Θολαθ ; apparently = אֶלְתּוֺלַד q. v. above.
